form: np.packbits of the canonical grid cell order (grid-aligned, no firm identifiers)
derivation: forma_fgrid ensemble finite predictions INTERSECT truth-finite (target actual AND origin baseline present). forma_fgrid is the binding coverage constraint of the 8-model Full pool, so this equals the full pooled join.
note: The prebuilt mask is Compustat-derived, so it is not bundled in this Apache-2.0 repository: it is published from the gated dataset repo above and lands at local_path via download_command (which md5-verifies it against the md5 above). build_command rebuilds it offline from the forma_fgrid ensemble forecast and reproduces the same md5.
